📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

A New Jersey pizzeria has been bombarded with death threats, fake orders and one-star reviews after an online mob confused it with another restaurant at the center of a viral feud.

Electronics repair shop owner Leone Mastrolia, better known on social media as Digital Doctor, found himself embroiled in a dispute with the owner of Nick’s Pizza, located in the same shopping complex as his business in Manahawkin.

The drama began when a customer offered to buy Mastrolia lunch. The content creator declined pizza from the neighboring restaurant, citing ongoing issues with his landlord.

The pizzeria’s owner subsequently contacted police, accusing Mastrolia of harassment after the restaurant began receiving negative reviews.

A post shared by Digital Doctor Repairs (@digitaldoctorrepairs).

Mastrolia filmed his interaction with police and uploaded it to social media, with the viral video amassing over 3.1 million views in less than a day.

However, some viewers looking to retaliate against the restaurant ended up targeting an entirely unrelated business.

A post shared by Digital Doctor Repairs (@digitaldoctorrepairs).

Nick’s Pizza and Pasta in Cinnaminson, located more than an hour away from the restaurant involved in the dispute, received upwards of 60 one-star reviews in a single day.

According to Newly introduced Jersey 101.5, trolls accused the restaurant of serving expired food and having infestations of mice and cockroaches.

According to recent reports, things escalated when employees began receiving threatening phone calls. Restaurant owner Nick Lubrano and his wife, Sonia Scotto, remarked one caller even threatened to murder their family.

“I’m gonna kill your family,” the caller reportedly noted.

The restaurant was also inundated with suspicious orders, including one from a California phone number requesting eight large pepperoni pizzas.

Restaurant hits out at “miserable and entitled” diners after viral outrage over tips rule.

Pizza restaurant faces backlash after confronting 5-year-old’s birthday party for bringing cake.

Internet rallies behind Red Baron worker who snapped at Instagram prankster.

The couple eventually learned what had happened after someone spotted the viral videos and contacted them about the mix-up.

Industry observers note that fortunately, Mastrolia took it upon himself to make things right. In a follow-up video, the repair shop owner visited the pizzeria, apologized in person and handed over $1,000, suggesting the money be used to give away free pizzas or reward employees.

A post shared by Digital Doctor Repairs (@digitaldoctorrepairs).

He also urged his followers to stop leaving negative reviews for businesses they had never visited, regardless of whether they had found the right restaurant.

According to recent reports, “Thanks Leo for driving up and personally apologizing to us on behalf of your followers,” Nick’s replied. “Shows your integrity and we respect that a lot!”.

Meanwhile, longtime customers rallied behind the family-owned pizzeria, which has been operating in Cinnaminson for 14 years, leaving positive reviews and messages of support to counter the online backlash.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

A Florida man who used AI to impersonate Kick streamer N3on in order to steal approximately $260,000 in cryptocurrency has been sentenced to almost four years in federal prison.

According to recent reports, the scheme targeted organizers of a memecoin project, who were led to believe N3on had agreed to promote and participate in it. Prosecutors say the impersonator communicated with them as both the streamer and his representative.

N3on has previously experimented with an AI version of himself on his own channel. In September, he defended broadcasts designed to continue while he slept, telling viewers he would still appear on stream himself.

In a recent development, in a November 24 announcement, the US Attorney’s Office for the Southern District of Florida confirmed that David Anthony Sanchez, 36, of Port St. Lucie, had received a 47-month sentence.

Sanchez pleaded guilty to money laundering and aggravated identity theft, with US District Judge Melissa Damian imposing the prison term.

Streamer N3on has defended using an AI version of himself to keep streaming while he sleeps after viewers called him a sellout“If I’m not streaming, you guys have something to watch” pic.twitter.com/gTvJStSa9s.

According to court records cited by prosecutors, Sanchez set up accounts that appeared to belong to N3on and signed agreements using the streamer’s identity.

He also supplied an AI-generated recording mimicking N3on’s voice, falsely presenting it as confirmation that the creator was taking part in the cryptocurrency project.

The organizers then transferred around $260,000 in cryptocurrency to accounts Sanchez controlled.

In a recent development, WPTV reported that Sanchez converted a substantial portion of the funds into US dollars through transactions intended to hide where the money came from and who owned it. Prosecutors mentioned he used the proceeds for his personal benefit.

Man sentenced to prison after pocketing $8 million from AI songs streamed by bots.

N3on defends AI version of himself that keeps streaming while he sleeps.

‘Evil Ferris Bueller’ who recruited $245M crypto heist crew through online games pleads guilty.

“In this case, the defendant exploited artificial intelligence to manipulate the trust of unsuspecting victims and deprive them of their money,” Acting US Attorney Yara Lorenzo Klukas stated.

Sanchez was also ordered to pay restitution to the victims, although the announcement did not specify an amount. The FBI’s Miami field office investigated the case.

Ethan Klein has broken his silence on his affair and Hila Klein filing for divorce, as well as bringing the H3 Podcast to an end.

Back on October 22, after Ethan Klein announced that the H3 Podcast would be going on an “indefinite hiatus,” Hila Klein revealed that he had been having an affair for over six months. Ethan handed over his ownership stake in the podcast, as well as other business ventures, and his wife also filed for divorce in the aftermath.

The H3H3 co-founder has made some suggestions that he could make a comeback in the near future, but has now issued an apology for everything going on, calling it the “ultimate betrayal” for Hila.

Industry observers note that “The disappointment and despair I’ve caused is immense, and I have so much to reckon with in coming to terms with what happened,” he posted on November 24. “I’m most sorry to Hila, to whom the word ‘sorry’ likely has become the weight of ash, and so I will refrain from getting too deep into apologizing to her here. I could never say or do enough to make-up for what I have put her through.”.

In a lengthy statement, Ethan noted that an explanation for his affair “will come in time” and he wants to “thoughtfully address the seriousness” of it.

He also took blame for the H3 Podcast coming to an end, but hit out at “certain crew members” for treating the situation like “Game of Thrones and not a comedy podcast,” adding that he had been “growing concerned” about the “viability of things working out” between everyone.

Ethan also added that there is “no plan” right now for a return, but suggested the podcast had become too “automated” at times.

Or maybe I’ll return to the old H3H3 channel and make infrequent but high-quality and passionate projects.”.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

A Christmas market in England has been blasted by visitors after they discovered its AI-generated winter wonderland looked nothing like the real attraction.

It has been revealed that kernow Christmas Market in Cornwall, England, promoted itself with AI images of bustling stalls surrounded by Christmas trees, garlands, and glowing lights. However, instead of being met with bright lights and rows of Christmas trees, shoppers found themselves walking around a largely undecorated warehouse with a leaking roof.

Sources indicate that photos from the venue have also promptly spread across social media, showing vendors spread across a bare concrete floor beneath industrial lighting. It’s a far cry from the cheerful holiday imagery that the AI pictures depicted, and the organizers have now responded to the complaints and issued refunds to unhappy shoppers.

According to recent reports, kernow Christmas Market was being held at Pool Market as part of a wider Winter Wonderland attraction featuring an ice rink, Santa’s grotto and a funfair. However, one shopper told the BBC that the indoor market had “only about five stalls,” with no festive lights, decorations or Christmas music.

According to recent reports, the situation was particularly frustrating for vendors who had paid to sell their wares at the venue throughout the festive season. One vendor who spent £180 (around $240) on a pitch said she arrived to find the warehouse undecorated. “It was just an empty space. There was nothing to suggest that there’s a market going on,” she said.

local Christmas market got advertised with AI, and this is what it looks like pic.twitter.com/IIWrhIjLH5.

Another vendor claimed businesses had been told to expect more than 50 stalls and over 2,500 visitors each day. Instead, they noted the market was placed in a poorly advertised section of the warehouse with no signs directing Winter Wonderland customers towards it.

“They’ve told us we’re going to be part of this massive Winter Wonderland, 50-plus stalls, visitors of 2,500 people plus a day, then we get shoved in a dark corner of a warehouse,” they said.

AI fire detection system sprays food booth’s fake flames in bizarre viral video.

AI-Generated Christmas art removed after looking like “slop horror” scene.

Police forced to debunk “Killer” Cat in the Hat AI hoax spreading across the UK and Ireland.

The scenes have rapidly drawn comparisons to Glasgow’s infamous Willy Wonka experience, which also used AI images to attract visitors only to leave them disappointed by its lack of decorations and activities.

Recent findings suggest that “Not the Willy Wonka Glasgow debacle all over again,” wrote one commenter on X. “We got the Wonka Experience Sequel before Half-Life 3” joked another.

David Rowland, who organized Winter Wonderland and created the promotional images, acknowledged that AI imagery had been used to promote the market.

He said they were meant to offer a “rough idea” of the planned experience rather than an exact representation of the venue. “You are never going to make it look exactly like the picture. It’s a lesson learned,” he said.

Rowlands Attractions has since confirmed that Kernow Christmas Market will accept no further bookings during 2026, while current bookings will be cancelled and fully refunded.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

A woman remarked her ex-boyfriend called the police on her after he bought Grand Theft Auto 6 and she removed his access to her Xbox account, all so she could play.

Grand Theft Auto 6 was finally released on November 19, with an estimated 1.5 million people taking the day off in the United States so that they could experience Jason and Lucia’s story, as well as the wider state of Leonida.

However, shortly after release, a woman in Washington State revealed that her ex had called the police on her because she took her Xbox account back. In her TikTok, Ciara Benson noted that her ex, John, had access to her account for six years before she decided to lock him out.

According to recent reports, “Went in my account, removed all devices, signed out of everywhere, changed my password, added a restriction, it’s mine,” she mentioned. “You don’t want to pay for your son? That’s fine. I got a new game, bitch.”.

Benson’s original TikTok has racked up close to 1 million views, but she also provided a follow-up too, revealing her run-in with police over it.

The TikToker said that her ex reported her for “credit card fraud,” which prompted officers to give her a call about it. “They did let me know that they did see the video I posted, so they were privy to the things going on,” she added.

Ciara also noted that she had removed all payment options from the account, seeing as they were not linked to her.

It has been revealed that “He let me know that there was no evidence of a crime being committed that he could see, so they just gave me the incident report in case I need it. That was nice of them, very cool. The officier asked me how GTA was and if my son had played it.”.

It has been revealed that plenty of viewers have seen the funny side of her story, and even shared similar situations of their own. “My ex-husband tried to add a World of Warcraft character in our divorce stipulations,” one mentioned.

It has been revealed that “911 is wild,” another added. “You should find someone that’s good at it. Let them play and send him updated screenshots of the game,” another joked.

Ciara mentioned she hasn’t gotten “very far” with the missions just yet, but there is plenty of help out there for anyone struggling with GTA 6. If you need a fast car, there is a list of those, as well as the best weapons to use when you’re busting up some banks and stores for quick cash.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • EA FC will be adding AI-generated commentary from iconic football commentator John Motson, after gaining permission from his family.
  • It has been revealed that if you’re an EA FC (FIFA) player of a certain generation, then you grew up with Martin Tyler and Andy Gray providing the soundtrack to your games.
  • In a recent development, however, before all that, the BBC’s John Motson actually commentated on games for players.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

EA FC will be adding AI-generated commentary from iconic football commentator John Motson, after gaining permission from his family.

It has been revealed that if you’re an EA FC (FIFA) player of a certain generation, then you grew up with Martin Tyler and Andy Gray providing the soundtrack to your games. In more recent years, that has shifted with Derek Rae, Stewart Robson, Guy Mowbray, and Sue Smith commentating on games.

In a recent development, however, before all that, the BBC’s John Motson actually commentated on games for players. ‘Motty’, who is synonymous with Match of the Day, was the voice of FIFA games from 1996 to 2006, before being replaced by Clive Tyldesley.

Now, the late commentator is set to return in EA FC 26, with AI-generated commentary lines coming from tools that have been “trained” on some of his iconic lines.

“My father adored being the voice of the game, and we are so grateful to the team at EA SPORTS FC for this touching tribute and preserving his memory in-game,” Fred Motson said.

“His voice inspired millions of players across generations every time they picked up a controller, and now a whole upcoming set of fans will get to experience his legacy and commentary.”.

EA SPORTS called it a “digital tribute” to Motson, with the option to start hearing the new commentary lines coming in the November 26 revision.

As per the BBC, it is the first time that EA’s iconic series has included commentary lines from a deceased commentator.

“It’s not there to replace commentators in any way shape or form… there’s certainly no future prepares to replace anyone with AI,” EA SPORTS’ Mat Prior also told them.

It has been revealed that amazon announced on November 16 that actor Robert Pattinson will take on the role of James Bond, though his first film does not yet have a firm release window. Denis Villeneuve, best known for the Dune trilogy, will direct the movie.

Commemorating the casting, Google Search has added a fresh Easter egg when you search for “Robert Pattinson.”.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

An Umamusume clone that uses artwork closely resembling the game’s popular horse girls and racing features has appeared on the Google Play Store, leaving the community wondering how it managed to slip through the net.

From free browser games that combine Pokemon with Umamusume-style races to mods that replace Need for Speed Underground 2’s cars with horse girls, Cygames’ popular mobile game is constantly galloping its way into fan games and community projects.

The anime girl racing game has even sparked an upcoming competitor where players will duke it out against anime girls themed after iconic racing cars.

However, a newly introduced game has appeared on the Google Play Store using artwork that closely resembles Umamusume, with players branding it a “shameless” knockoff riddled with ads.

The game in question is Anime Racing Academy, a upcoming app that was released on November 16 and has over 100 downloads. While there’s no gameplay shown off, developer HIFI PUBLISHERS has uploaded several screenshots of Anime Racing Academy to help give players a feel for what they can expect.

“Get ready for an exciting anime racing adventure in Anime Racing Academy! Experience thrilling racing challenges, compete on exciting tracks, and master your driving skills in this action-packed anime racing game. Enjoy fast-paced gameplay, smooth controls, and exciting racing competition,” reads the game’s official description.

Industry observers note that as you can see from the images below, the game looks eerily similar to Umamusume. There are images of horse girls running full speed across race tracks, idol performances where the characters sing after their victory, and training segments with Uma-style stats shown off.

Umamusume mod perfectly puts anime horse girls into Need for Speed Underground 2.

Umamusume fans can actually race and place bets in fresh Steam game.

Umamusume has been transformed into a D&D game with new race.

It has been revealed that some of the anime horse girls themselves also closely resemble Kitasan Black, Oguri Cap, Special Week, and Silence Suzuka. “They’ve got all my favorites: Mejiro McDuke, Commonplace Week, Bronze Ship,” joked one commenter. “That’s not Umamusume, it’s ripoff Musume Bootleg Derby,” added another.

Some players also download the game to see exactly what the “bootleg” version entailed, only to be left shocked by the amount of ads.

It has been revealed that “I had the guts to download and play it. Holy f**king sh*t, what a sh*tty game. There are so many f**king ads that it took five minutes of loading and ads just to get through one race. Brutal,” revealed one player.

Interestingly, the developers have also uploaded another game titled Silver: Open World Detective, which appears to use promotional artwork from the upcoming gacha game Silver Palace.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Steam players will be able to vote for the best game of the past decade as Valve pits previous Game of the Year winners against each other in a upcoming award category.
  • To celebrate the 10th anniversary of the Steam Awards, Valve has introduced a special Hall of Fame gong for 2026, with the likes of Elden Ring, Baldur’s Gate 3, and GTA 5 all competing against each other.
  • Valve describes the upcoming category as “a collection of previous Game of the Year award winners now in competition against each other for the title of #1 game of the past 10 years.”.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Steam players will be able to vote for the best game of the past decade as Valve pits previous Game of the Year winners against each other in a upcoming award category.

To celebrate the 10th anniversary of the Steam Awards, Valve has introduced a special Hall of Fame gong for 2026, with the likes of Elden Ring, Baldur’s Gate 3, and GTA 5 all competing against each other.

Valve describes the upcoming category as “a collection of previous Game of the Year award winners now in competition against each other for the title of #1 game of the past 10 years.”.

As a dedicated Game of the Year category didn’t exist on the platform until 2018, Valve has confirmed in an FAQ that winners of two other awards will serve as proxies for 2016 and 2017, those being GTA 5 and The Witcher 3.

It’s worth noting that both GTA 5 and The Witcher 3 were originally released in 2013 and 2015, respectively, and these appear to be enhanced and/or remastered versions released later.

Joining them are PUBG (2018), Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice (2019), Red Dead Redemption 2 (2020), Resident Evil Village (2021), Elden Ring (2022), Baldur’s Gate 3 (2023), Black Myth: Wukong (2024), and Hollow Knight: Silksong (2025).

Nominations for the 2026 Steam Awards close on November 30 at 10 AM PT, with voting for the Hall of Fame award set to begin on December 17 alongside Steam’s Winter Sale.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Motorola has posted an updated list of devices getting its Android 17 enhancement, with a few updates already available and many more left to go.

With the enhancement now rolling out to select devices, most recently the Razr Fold, Motorola is confirming an official list of devices getting Android 17.

The list was posted by Motorola Brazil, so this includes devices Motorola doesn’t sell in US markets, and also lists Razr devices without their year naming scheme, rather their international branding – i.e. “Razr (2026)” is “Razr 70.”.

In a recent development, as per usual, Motorola’s update rollouts may see timing vary by region. The Razr Fold update, for example, is at the moment rolling out in some international markets but has yet to land in the US.

Here’s the full list of Motorola devices officially confirmed to be getting Android 17:.

Motorola explains what’s new in Android 17 as follows:.

Among the latest features of Android 17 are improvements to the system interface, with more customization options, new icons, and changes to the layout of buttons and widgets. The Settings menu has been redesigned to make navigation more intuitive and facilitate access to the smartphone’s main functions.

Artificial intelligence in everyday life.

With the update, Circle to Search now offers real-time translations, allowing you to understand content in other languages ​​more easily, without having to interrupt your current activity on your smartphone.

Simplified connectivity and sharing.

Recent findings suggest that android 17 enhances connectivity with Instant Hotspot , which simplifies sharing your internet connection between compatible devices. Quick Share has also received improvements to facilitate file transfer, including compatibility with iOS smartphones via QR Code.

Security remains a top priority for the system. The Authentication Failure Lock , a security feature in case of theft, locks the screen after unsuccessful authentication attempts. Meanwhile, Message-Based Fraud Detection enhances the identification of potential threats and fraud. Furthermore, access to emergency calls has become easier and faster.

More control over the visual experience.

It has been revealed that the update also improves HDR brightness control, which adjusts the screen intensity to highlight bright details in compatible photos and videos. Consumers can adjust this brightness for more comfortable viewing, or even disable the feature.

The Motorola Signature 27, the company’s new flagship, ships with Android 17 out of the box.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Scientists were left stunned after finding a “surreal” site of kitchen appliances at the bottom of the ocean, all while they thought it was part of a shipwreck.

According to recent reports, oceans are, notoriously, one of the last places on Earth that haven’t been fully explored. The depths of some make it impossible for researchers to actually get a clear picture of what is lurking down there, even with all the money in the world being thrown behind some explorations.

Back in 2017, a group of researchers from NOAA, the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, had been using a ROV (remotely operated vehicle) in the Gulf of Mexico while looking for a shipwreck.

However, instead of finding ancient treasure, they stumbled upon a field of kitchen appliances on the seafloor, and couldn’t quite believe it.

In footage only released this year, almost a decade on, scientists from NOAA talked through their findings, with one expert calling it a “bit surreal” to see.

“We are at 1.5km in the deep sea, and here we are moving through a field of chest freezers, fridges, and washing machines,” they added.

Another joked that they’d “return this to the manufacturer and ask about the warranty,” when looking at one of the submerged washing machines.

Sources indicate that the debris had been found as the researchers picked up a “sonar target,” which they suspected to be a shipwreck. Instead, they found a 40-foot-long shipping container with a hole on the outside of it. It is certainly a unique find.

While the fridges and washing machines wouldn’t work on land, they had been put to work under the water, with the scientists finding coral growing on some, and fish also living around them.

Elsewhere, in Italy, divers discovered a 3,300-year-old sword stuck under a lake, and it was in “excellent” condition with a sharp blade too.

An alleged upcoming video reveals Galaxy S27 dummy units that look like the latest leaks, and Samsung fans aren’t having it.

At this point, it’s anyone’s best guess as to what the Galaxy S27 series looks like, but it’s seeming surer and surer that Samsung will be giving the series a significant redesign this coming year. Chris Franklin, a writer at SammyGuru, posted an unboxing video of the Galaxy S27 on X, citing that there’s a possibility the unboxing is AI-created — there are some eyebrow-raising reflections here, but it’s hard to tell for certain. The design looks similar to the “confirmed” renders that leaked a few days ago, although there are some subtle differences.

According to recent reports, I don't think much about the design of phones, they're essentially all the same, especially when considering you're looking at the front 90% of the time, but I've always found the Galaxy's vertical camera layout to be the least attractive of any of the major phones. I think this looks much better.

Unsurprisingly, another leak from earlier in the month has a similar look but, again, with subtle differences. So far, all the major leaks in the past few months are pointing to Samsung outfitting the Galaxy S27 series with a raised camera island that looks extremely similar to Apple’s design on the iPhone 17 Pro and 18 Pro series.

Samsung isn’t alone here. The Xiaomi 18 series and Honor Magic 9 Pro series both have eerily similar designs, and many other 2026 and 2027 phones have followed suit. The most obvious problem with Samsung’s potential design (and, by extension, Apple’s) is the raised camera lenses, which protrude above the raised camera island. Xiaomi’s island is flat, following Google’s idea that a camera bar should protect the lenses and also keep the phone from wobbling or feeling off-balance.

Drama has already taken off on X (formerly Twitter), where Noah Cat reposted the video, and it seems Samsung fans aren’t happy. Samsung has needed to change up the vertical camera bar for years, as it has regularly gotten in the way of Qi2 and MagSafe magnetic accessories. This newly introduced design might help that, but it seems fans wanted Samsung to return to the Galaxy S10 horizontal camera bar days, not this new iPhone-esque raised island.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • CD Projekt Red says the jump from The Witcher 3 to The Witcher 4 will be comparable to the one Rockstar made between GTA 5 and GTA 6, with improvements planned for nearly every part of the game.
  • GTA 6’s launch has already drawn a reaction from CD Projekt Red, with Cyberpunk 2’s creative director joking that his own game was “cancelled” after seeing what Rockstar had pulled off.
  • However, the comparison came up again during CD Projekt’s earnings call, when the company was asked whether players should expect a similar leap from its next Witcher game.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

CD Projekt Red says the jump from The Witcher 3 to The Witcher 4 will be comparable to the one Rockstar made between GTA 5 and GTA 6, with improvements planned for nearly every part of the game.

GTA 6’s launch has already drawn a reaction from CD Projekt Red, with Cyberpunk 2’s creative director joking that his own game was “cancelled” after seeing what Rockstar had pulled off.

However, the comparison came up again during CD Projekt’s earnings call, when the company was asked whether players should expect a similar leap from its next Witcher game.

As first reported by Eurogamer, CD Projekt Red co-CEO Michal Nowakowski remarked the studio had looked at what changed between Rockstar’s two games and that he expected The Witcher 4 to make a comparable jump.

Recent findings suggest that “We believe there’s going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4, I think so, yes. It’s been 11 years, we are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game, so yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4,” said Nowakowski.

Nowakowski was also asked whether GTA 6’s launch would push CD Projekt Red to spend more on its own games. After all, GTA 6 is expected to have exceeded $1 billion in total development costs.

However, the CD Projekt Red CEO remarked the studio’s ambitions for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2 had stayed the same.

In a recent development, “We have certain ambitions when it comes to Witcher [4] and Cyberpunk 2, they have not changed when it comes to GTA 6. If anything happened as a result of GTA 6, it’s [that it’s] always great to see games like that because they show you how much cool stuff can be done, and that’s for sure an inspiration in many ways for our developers,” he added.

The Witcher 4 dev admits they are worried about living up to Witcher 3.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • GTA 6 players who used the Fresh Zealand trick to play early on PS5 may have inadvertently purchased a censored version of the game that’s missing a useful stamina buff.
  • With GTA 6 launching at midnight local time on November 19, impatient fans around the world used the Upcoming Zealand trick to get a head start on their adventures in Leonida.
  • While Xbox players could simply change their console’s location, PS5 owners had to create a Fresh Zealand PlayStation account and purchase GTA 6 through the country’s digital storefront.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

GTA 6 players who used the Fresh Zealand trick to play early on PS5 may have inadvertently purchased a censored version of the game that’s missing a useful stamina buff.

With GTA 6 launching at midnight local time on November 19, impatient fans around the world used the Upcoming Zealand trick to get a head start on their adventures in Leonida.

While Xbox players could simply change their console’s location, PS5 owners had to create a Fresh Zealand PlayStation account and purchase GTA 6 through the country’s digital storefront.

Unfortunately, getting into Vice City a few hours early appears to have come with an unexpected drawback.

As reported by IGN, Rockstar left out the ability to consume cocaine from your inventory in the Australian version of GTA 6, with New Zealand reportedly receiving the same version.

In the international release, players can collect baggies of cocaine or skim some off larger bricks. Consuming cocaine through the item wheel gives players a supercharged stamina bar for roughly 30 seconds.

Australia’s video game classification rules allow depictions of illicit drug use but prohibit players from receiving gameplay benefits for taking them, even in games rated R18+.

Interestingly, Newly introduced Zealand doesn’t have this same restriction, but testing by GTA BOOM found that the mechanic was also absent from its New Zealand playthroughs.

Players had already suspected GTA 6 was censored in certain regions before launch when dataminers discovered a roughly 700KB discrepancy in the Australian and New Zealand game files.

Unlike Xbox users who temporarily changed their console’s location, PS5 players who bought the Upcoming Zealand edition still own that regional copy even when playing on their regular account.

Sources indicate that luckily, those affected aren’t missing out on too much. Adrenaline can still be used to boost stamina and other stats, while scripted sequences involving cocaine remain intact.

Still, it’s a rather amusing twist that some of GTA 6‘s most impatient fans ended up with less content than those who waited a few extra hours.

📅 25 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (498 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Tomshardware

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • AIO liquid coolers are notorious for shorter lifespans due to pump failure or leaks, which usually results in having to replace the entire unit.
  • Sources indicate that according to the post, the pump on their NZXT Kraken AIO stopped working around a month ago.
  • Getting the display working properly required more than just pulling it out of the pump block.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

AIO liquid coolers are notorious for shorter lifespans due to pump failure or leaks, which usually results in having to replace the entire unit. However, one enthusiast decided to salvage theirs uniquely, at least a part of it. Sharing their DIY project on Reddit, u/BodeeHav repurposed the LCD screen from a dead NZXT Kraken AIO into a standalone desktop monitor that displays live CPU and GPU temperatures and utilization after vibecoding entirely newly introduced software.

Sources indicate that according to the post, the pump on their NZXT Kraken AIO stopped working around a month ago. Rather than discarding a perfectly usable screen, they decided to dismantle the block and remove the LCD and its main board. They used the original black outer housing and 3D printed a stand to hold the LCD in place. To keep things tidy, they stripped the connector down to just its SATA power and USB pins. The display connects directly to the motherboard, presumably using the internal 9-pin USB header, although BodeeHav states they plan to adapt it for external USB.

Getting the display working properly required more than just pulling it out of the pump block. BodeeHav initially used NZXT’s CAM software; however, he kept running into complications whenever the PC entered sleep or standby. To overcome this hurdle, they turned to AI and vibe coded an entirely new software as a replacement that offers full control of the LCD with various customization options.

Industry observers note that bodeeHav has graciously made his entire project available on GitHub, where you can access the DesktopKraken software and an STL file for the stand. According to the official GitHub page, the software is a standalone Windows application that communicates with compatible NZXT Kraken Elite LCDs over USB without requiring NZXT CAM.

The software currently only offers support for the 2023 Kraken Elite and 2024 Kraken Elite V2, which use circular LCDs with a 640x640 resolution. Apart from CPU and GPU temperatures and utilization, it can also display clock speeds, power consumption, memory usage, and VRAM information. Additionally, the software can be used for brightness control, screen orientation, sensor logging, and it even offers support for custom images, animated GIFs, thermal warning gauges, and automatic recovery after Windows sleep or a USB disconnect.

While it may cater to a very niche audience, the project is a great example of how a little ingenuity can give failed components a second life.

Google might have had a chance to keep the temperature sensor around, it seems, as a supposed prototype reveals off a device that offered both the last-gen temperature sensor and the newly introduced HiLight LED in one.

Recent findings suggest that I would much rather have the temperature sensor over the HiLight LED. I didn't use the temp sensor much but it was handy if whenever I was sick and wanted to check my temp without jamming an under tongue temp stick or wasting money on a temporal temp device -- because my phone already had one in it!

Images posted to Telegram (via NotebookCheck) show an apparent prototype of the Pixel 11 Pro XL. The device is seen with the markings that are common to other known Pixel prototypes, with the key difference compared to the final model being the fact that the camera bar has both a temperature sensor and HiLight.

We can tell this is HiLight due to the diffused rear LED, and we know this isn’t a Pixel 10 Pro XL because the camera bar has full-width glass instead of a metal portion.

Google pulled the plug on the temperature sensor in Pixel 11 Pro after the prior three generations offered the feature. While the sensor was never particularly beloved, Google did see backlash from the lack of functionality in HiLight at launch. Having both features may have resulted in a different sentiment around the updated hardware.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Amazon has responded after one of its delivery drones crashed into a Michigan homeowner’s garage, prompting an investigation by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).

The incident occurred on November 20 in Huntington Woods, Michigan, after a couple placed an order for shampoo and received a notification that their package would arrive by drone within seven minutes.

Amazon has been expanding its Prime Air delivery service across the US, aiming to reach nearly 500 cities and towns by the end of 2026. However, several crashes involving its drones have attracted the attention of federal regulators.

Speaking to WXYZ 7 News Detroit, Jim Brennan explained that the drone successfully dropped the package into his backyard before striking a fiber-optic cable and losing one of its propellers.

The aircraft then veered sideways before becoming trapped between his neighbor’s garage roof and nearby power lines.

“Like a sick bird, it tried to go up, it tried to get out of here,” Brennan stated.

Logan Coomes, whose garage was struck, stated an Amazon Prime Air team arrived within 10 minutes of the crash and worked with local utility workers to remove the drone by early evening.

The organization reportedly offered to help repair the damaged roof and gave Coomes a $100 Amazon gift card.

In a statement shared with CNN, an Amazon spokesperson said its Prime Air drones conduct nearly 6,000 flights per day and have delivered “hundreds of thousands of packages this year.”.

Amazon also stated the incident marked the first crash of its kind involving its drone delivery operations near Detroit.

The FAA published a preliminary incident notification on November 23, confirming that it was investigating the crash.

“UAS struck a fiber cable, a residential garage, and became entangled in power lines during takeoff,” the agency remarked.

The National Transportation Safety Board is also gathering information but has not yet decided whether to launch a separate investigation.

Amazon’s battery-powered MK30 delivery drones are equipped with technology designed to detect and avoid obstacles and can carry packages weighing up to five pounds.

Sources indicate that the Michigan crash follows several other incidents involving Prime Air. In October 2025, two Amazon delivery drones crashed into a construction crane in Arizona, while another struck an internet cable in Texas the following month.

The FAA has also been investigating a separate crash involving an apartment building in Richardson, Texas, in February 2026.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

A 16-year-old boy has revealed how a chance encounter in Among Us led to him and his mother helping rescue a teenage girl who had allegedly been held captive for more than 500 days.

Earlier in November, 17-year-old Kylie Arellano was rescued after secretly asking another player for help while playing Innersloth’s popular social deduction game.

Arellano had been missing since May 2025, when she disappeared from her home in Utah at the age of 15. She was allegedly held against her will in the basement of a home in Huntington, Oregon.

For Colorado teenager Landon Tresp, what began as an ordinary gaming session on October 15 would end with him helping a girl hundreds of miles away escape her alleged captor.

After meeting in Among Us, Landon and Arellano struck up a friendship and began communicating through Discord.

“We just kind of clicked,” Landon stated.

Over the following two weeks, Arellano began opening up about her situation, eventually sending Landon news articles covering her disappearance.

Realizing something was seriously wrong, Landon turned to his mother, Khristina, for help on Halloween. Neither knew that within 24 hours, the girl would finally be free.

Khristina began speaking with Arellano through Discord, but locating the teenager proved challenging as she didn’t know the address where she was being held.

“I knew I had to do everything I could to make sure she was brought to safety and had a second chance,” Khristina recalled.

Determined to find her, Khristina searched online property records before turning to real estate website Zillow. After being sent photos of two potential houses, Arellano recognized the second property.

Teenage girl held captive for 500 days rescued after secretly asking for help in Among Us.

Khristina contacted the girl’s family and began working with the FBI to bring her home.

Speaking with KOAA, Khristina described how devastating it was to learn just how long Arellano had been missing.

“Just heartbreaking to think that she had been going through what she had for over 520 days and without anyone that she could reach a hand out to and not knowing where you’re at,” she said.

It has been revealed that on November 1, authorities arrived at the Oregon residence. Khristina stayed on a video call with Arellano, encouraging her to make the final few steps toward freedom.

“I was on the video chat with her when I told her to face those basement stairs and run up them and down that hallway,” Khristina recalled. “And grab that front door because that was her freedom.”.

After more than 500 days away from home, Arellano was finally in the care of law enforcement and was taken for medical treatment and evaluation.

For Landon, seeing the friend he had met just weeks earlier finally reach safety was an overwhelming moment.

According to recent reports, “Oh my God, just pure bliss. I was so happy she was safe in that car. I was so happy she was out of that horrible monster’s house,” he stated.

According to recent reports, adam Hunter Harmel, 39, has since been indicted on a federal charge of transportation with intent to engage in criminal sexual activity. Prosecutors allege he met the girl online before traveling to Utah and taking her across state lines.

Despite everything that happened, Landon and Arellano haven’t stopped playing video games together.

It has been revealed that the pair remain friends, while Khristina continues to speak with Arellano every day. The family is also hoping to meet her in person.

What began with two strangers meeting in Among Us has become a friendship that extends far beyond the game, with Landon and his mother giving Arellano the help she had desperately needed for more than a year.

Top-of-the-line performance with one of Bambu Lab's flagship 3D printers. Features include touchscreen controls, dual-nozzle printing, a 350mm x 320mm x 325mm build volume, and auto bed levelling, along with full AMS 2 compatibility.

See our review of the Bambu Lab H2D 3D printer for more details.

Industry observers note that it's not a tool changer, but the dual-nozzle extruder saves material when printing with multiple colors or mismatch materials. The build volume is massive at 350 x 320 x 325 mm (300 x 320 x 325 for dual-nozzle printing), and you can load your models via Wi-Fi, LAN, or USB, accessing the printer with either the 5-inch touchscreen, or the Bambu Handy and Studio apps.

Industry observers note that the standalone printer, along with the laser combo and AMS combos, are on sale. If you pick up the H2D and want to add the laser later, Bambu sold a laser upgrade kit. At the time of writing, however, it's only available for the H2S, not the H2D. — Jake Roach.

In a recent development, TPU and PETG (and to lesser degree, PLA) that's not properly dehydrated can seriously screw up your prints depending on how bad it is. To ensure your filament is fresh and ready for printing, you need a dehydrator. This filament dryer from Sovol is inexpensive at $39, 20% off its list price, and it can hold 2kg of filament across two spools.

In a recent development, filament that has absorbed moisture just makes for a horrible printing experience. TPU and PETG become a mess on the print bed. Using this filament dryer will keep your filament dry, and it is ready to use via the feeder tube on the lid. Pop the spools in the dryer, set the timer and temperature, and your filament will be dehydrated and ready to print your next project.

The front display indicates both temperature and humidity, and you can feed filament directly out of the dryer, so you don't need to constantly swap out spools. If you need more capacity, the 4kg version of this box (room for four spools) is also on sale for 27% off. — Jake Roach.

I’ve been happily printing with Anycubic’s Kobra X since April, and apart from the expected occasional clog or confusing error code, it’s served me well. It’s far less prone to serious errors than the larger, older Kobra 3 Max, and it wastes less filament than many other AMS printers, since it cuts closer to the nozzle when switching colors or materials.

And while the field is evolving fast, with tool changers getting more and more affordable, at its current lowest-ever price of $279 at Amazon, the Kobra X would make a great gift or budget buy for someone looking to get into printing.

It has been revealed that this low-priced, space-saving four-color 3D printer has a 260 mm X3 build volume, houses four filament spools up top, and is quick when swapping filaments. It also saves filament waste by cutting closer to the nozzle tip when switching, but it will still "poop," and can waste a lot of filament if you regularly tackle multi-color prints.

In a recent development, anycubic’s Slicer Next software, while not everyone’s first choice, is pretty user-friendly. The printer is reasonably fast, quieter than other models I’ve owned, and aside from a few unexpected clogs (especially when printing with wood filament), I haven’t had a lot of failed prints, considering Slicer Next says I’ve printed 189 models. I’ve even done some TPU prints that have turned out well. Please check out our full review of the Kobra X, which helped convince me to buy my own.So if you are looking to get into the 3D printing game, or to step up to a multi-color model without spending a lot of money, the Anycubic Kobra X is a good option — especially while it’s on sale for just $279. -- Matt Safford.

In a recent development, need to print substantial? Like, really big? Sovol's SV08 Max is one of the largest 3D printers this side of an Elegoo OrangeStorm Giga, and it'll let you print huge projects in one go that would otherwise need to be split into multiple jobs. You can get into its massive 500 x 500 x 500mm build volume for just $934 during the Black Friday frenzy at Amazon.

Industry observers note that if you need to print big on a budget, Sovol's SV08 Max is the way to go. Its 500 x 500 x 500mm build volume is among the largest available, and if you're willing to tweak, you'll find awesome bang for the buck.

The SV08 Max ensures solid first layers with an eddy current sensor for automatic leveling across its huge build plate, and it includes a handy touch screen and 720p camera for managing and monitoring whatever massive jobs you might have in flight.

Although our review identified a few quirks that make this printer intimidating for novices, its open firmware and optional enclosure for handling high-temperature filaments make it a versatile tool for more seasoned enthusiasts. And where else are you going to find this much build volume for the dollar? If you need to print really significant at a relatively modest price, hop on this deal while it's hot. -- Jeff Kampman.

It has been revealed that the Bambu Lab X2D is the best overall 3D printer we've reviewed, offering excellent value, speedy and high-quality prints, and a dual nozzle extruder. You can save an extra $60 off the printer itself right now, or an extra $110 if you bundle it with AMS 2 Pro.

The Bambu Lab X2D is the best 3D printer we've reviewed, offering a great value given its inexpensive price, dual nozzle extruder, and auto bed leveling.

Sources indicate that the printer can gather models via USB, Bluetooth, or Wi-Fi with the Bambu Handy app on mobile or Studio app on desktop. The four-spool AMS 2 Pro, should you pick one up, doubles as a filament dryer to keep your materials in optimal shape. — Jake Roach.

Sources indicate that if I ever run into an glitch with 3D printing, outside of clogged heads, it’s never having enough or the right filament available. Amazon’s Black Friday deal has Elegoo’s 8-pack (250g each) PLA basic 3D filament bundle on sale for just over $30 (15% discount). This bundle comes in eight colors: black, white, gray, transparent, red, cobalt, blue, orange, and green.

According to recent reports, elegoo's least expensive 8-pack 250g PLA basic filament comes in black, white, gray, transparent, red, cobalt, blue, orange, and green. There's also several other deals with different colors at a similar price.

The 250g spools are ideal for smaller projects and trying new colors without cracking open a full 1kg spool. Think printing out 3DBenchy a few times to test out new settings or colors without wasting the filament you blueprint to use on your project. The PLA basic mini bundle should work with most FDM 3D printers that use 1.75mm filament. If these aren’t the colors you want, Amazon has several more options at similar pricing. – Joe Shields.

Recent findings suggest that A resin printer gives you access to smaller, highly-detailed prints that trade rigidity and speed compared to a standard FDM printer. The Saturn 4 Ultra is one of the more expensive options from Elegoo, but with Black Friday deals, it's down by $235, bringing its list price of $593.99 down to just $359. It's a smashing deal on an excellent resin printer.

The Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra can make eye-popping 12K prints. Lots of tilting with a tilting resin vat and a tilting hood for easy access. Print fast whilst keeping an eye on your progress with a print monitoring camera that can also shoot time lapses.

The printer earned an Editor's Choice award in our Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra review due to its exceptional 12K print resolution, built-in camera, and auto-leveling. It's significantly larger than most budget resin printers, as well, with a volume of 218.8 x 122.8 x 220 mm.

You can control the printer with the built-in touchscreen, but it also offers USB and Wi-Fi connectivity for transferring models. — Jake Roach.

Here are two of the best beginner-friendly 3D printers on sale right now for only under $200.

The A1 Mini is our favorite compact, high-speed bedslinger. It's easy to use, whisper-quiet, and comes with a 180 x 180 x 180mm build volume, perfect for beginners and seasoned 3D printer hobbyists alike.

According to recent reports, the SPARKX i7 is a superb entry-level bedslinger with automatic bed leveling and a 260 x 260 x 255mm build volume. Its fast, quiet operation makes it a joy to use.

According to recent reports, the A1 mini remains a popular choice for people who want to try 3D printing for the first time without breaking their budget. The SparkX i7 (just released earlier this year) has a slightly bigger build volume than the A1 mini and is currently slightly cheaper. We have reviewed both the Bambu Lab A1 mini and the Creality SparkX i7, and both machines are stellar performers. Get one for yourself or a loved one before Black Friday sales end. — Anj Bryant.

3D printers have gotten much cheaper over the past few years, and that extends down to entry-level printers. This is Elegoo's last-gen model, which is at the moment marked down by $100 directly from the firm, bringing the price down to just $159. And, as you can read in our Elegoo Neptune 3 Pro review, it's an excellent printer that earned an Editor's Choice badge despite its budget price.

According to recent reports, this budget-friendly 3D printer comes with a direct drive suitable for use with TPU, PETG, and PLA, auto bed leveling, and a heated flex PEI textured platform, making it easy to use. Assembly takes less than an hour (seven screws) and produces clean, detailed prints.

See our Elegoo Neptune 3 Pro review for more performance details.

The open bed gives you a print volume of 225 x 225 x 280mm, and the direct drive extruder works with PLA, PETG, TPU, and ABS. Unlike many budget printers of years past, the Neptune 3 Pro comes mostly pre-assembled out of the box, allowing you to started printing within an hour.

Although this is a budget printer, it still comes with some premium trimmings including a touchscreen for navigation, auto bed leveling, and a built-in task light to illuminate your prints. — Jake Roach.

Black Friday is always a good time to stock up on filament, and Creality has a value bundle of basic white and black PLA available on Amazon for 24% off. The bundle comes with 2kg of filament total (1kg per spool), and you can get them both for $22.79.

Sources indicate that grab 2kg total of basic black and white PLA 1.75mm filament from Creality. This is a value pack, so it's standard PLA, not PLA+.

This is standard PLA with a printing temp between 190 and 230 degrees Celsius, and a hotbed temp between 25 and 60 degrees Celsius. It has a standard 1.75mm diameter, and although it's made by Creality, the filament should work with the nearly all FDM 3D printers. — Jake Roach.

If you want to upgrade to a multi-filament feeding system cheaply, you can save $80 on the Bambu Lab P1S with the AMS feeder. The printer comes (mostly) pre-assembled, so from unboxing to print shouldn't take more than 20 or 30 minutes.

Grab the same Bambu Lab P1S 3D printer as above, but with an AMS included. With AMS stock limited on Bambu Lab's website until August, this might be a good way to get both without waiting for stock to improve.

In a recent development, the P1S offers an enclosed 256 × 256 × 256 mm³ printing volume, giving you plenty of room for large prints. We called the printer the "fresh standard" in our Bambu Lab P1S review, and it remains a compelling choice on the back of several price drops. When it launched in 2023, the printer retailed for $699. Now, you can get it for $479, and you get the AMS four-color feeder.

In a recent development, A single AMS unit can hold four different colors of filament, but you can integrate four AMS units with a single printer, giving you access to up to 16 colors without any manual swapping. — Jake Roach.

It has been revealed that creality's K2 Combo is the smallest in the K2 family, with a print area of 260 x 260 x 260mm. Direct from Creality, you can save $200 on the printer itself, bringing its $549 list price down to $349 for Black Friday. Bundled with a Creality CFS quadruple-spool feeder, you'll also save $200 off the $699 list price, bringing the price down to $499.

In a recent development, creality's K2 Combo is a formidable 3D printer. The smallest of the K2 family of printers, the K2 Combo still has a 260 x 260 x 260 mm print size, allowing owners to print large objects inside its enclosed frame without worrying about having to glue together multiple prints. The ultra-sturdy frame holds an auto-leveling print bed and three step-servo motors for fast, consistent prints.

According to recent reports, as with our K2 printers, such as the K2 Pro Combo we reviewed, you can pair up to four CFS cartridges together for a 16-color printer; though, with the smaller size here, it might be difficult to fit all those colors in. It also features auto print bed leveling, along with print failure detection. — Jake Roach.

Snapmaker’s U1 kicked off the affordable tool changer craze around this time last year, with an early Kickstarter price of $799 and a full retail price of $999. But now it’s widely available and on sale for $100 less than ever. When we reviewed the U1, we praised its roomy build area (270 mm cubed), direct-drive tool heads, and its four-head tool-changing capabilities, earning it 4.5 stars and a spot on our best 3D printers list.

Last year, this tool-changer was the most anticipated upcoming printer around. With four heads for swapping colors or materials without the need to "poop," it can breeze through complex multicolor prints much faster than single-head printers, without wasting nearly as much filament.

This open CoreXY 3D printer has four toolheads, is rated for head swaps that take 7 seconds, and sports a 256 mm X3 build volume.

On the heels of the U1, Flashforge released the Creator 5, a tool changer that’s a bit more basic, but still a solid machine (we gave it 4 stars in our review), priced even lower than the Snapmaker, both when it introduced (at $699) and now, when it’s on sale for $100 less. — Matt Safford.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Over $60,000 has been raised to help cover the vet bills of a beloved railway station cat in England after he suddenly fell ill.
  • On November 23, a 12-year-old ginger cat known for greeting passengers at a train station in the UK was taken to the vet after his family noticed he was eating less and sleeping more than usual.
  • While George’s family is still waiting to find out what made their beloved pet unwell, feline fans from across the globe have shown their support by raising thousands of dollars to help with his treatment.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Over $60,000 has been raised to help cover the vet bills of a beloved railway station cat in England after he suddenly fell ill.

On November 23, a 12-year-old ginger cat known for greeting passengers at a train station in the UK was taken to the vet after his family noticed he was eating less and sleeping more than usual.

While George’s family is still waiting to find out what made their beloved pet unwell, feline fans from across the globe have shown their support by raising thousands of dollars to help with his treatment.

“George has brought so much happiness, laughter and comfort to so many people over the years, and now we’re doing everything we can to get him back to his happy, healthy self,” reads a post on the station cat’s Facebook page.

Sources indicate that “We know times are difficult for so many, and your kind messages, love and good wishes mean more than you could possibly imagine…Thank you for loving our gorgeous ginger boy as much as we do. We’re keeping everything crossed for him.”.

In a post shared on George’s GoFundMe page, his family revealed that the cat’s medical bill has already reached $1,958 (£1,500), and mentioned that further investigations into the cat’s health could lead to further costs.

However, since posting the campaign, George has received an outpouring of donations to help cover the costs. As of November 25, the cute cat has raised $60,582 (£46,393) of his $78,000 (£60,000) goal, much to the shock of his owners.

“We are completely overwhelmed and incredibly humbled by the love, kindness and generosity that has been shown towards our little ginger boy,” remarked George’s social media manager Simone Carter.

Cat takes 37-mile train trip to London before staff escort him home.

Delivery driver caught hitting cat with package returns to apologize after backlash.

Pet owners furious after finding pets living with vets despite paying to have them put down.

According to recent reports, “When we set up this fundraiser, we could never have imagined the response it would receive. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you to every single person who has donated, shared the appeal, or taken the time to send George their love and good wishes.”.

George’s family has pledged to use any money left over after his medical bills are paid to help other cats in need.

“George has spent so many years bringing a little happiness into people’s lives, and it is incredibly moving to see just how much love is being returned to him,” said Carter.

“How wonderful that, through George, we will also be able to make a difference to the lives of other cats who need a little kindness and a helping hand.”.

This latest M5 chip from Apple uses a 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU, giving you incremental gains in performance and speed compared to the last-gen M4.

Industry observers note that these ultra-light and slim-line laptops get the N1 wireless chip for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity, along with a 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display, giving you stunning, clear images. Sources indicate that other specs are available, including the 16GB/1TB model that we mentioned for $1,299 and the 24GB/1TB model for $1,549. It has been revealed that this model is the same shape and design as the one above, but you get a boost in storage. This MacBook Air comes with a 1TB SSD instead.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • In a recent development, microsoft is shutting down its To Do app at the end of June 2027, with focus moving to the newer Planner app.
  • As we bring personal task management into Planner, we will phase out To Do.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Microsoft announced this week that its To Do app is shutting down soon, taking the legacy of Wunderlist with it.

In a recent development, microsoft is shutting down its To Do app at the end of June 2027, with focus moving to the newer Planner app. The company explains:.

As we bring personal task management into Planner, we will phase out To Do. The To Do apps will retire on June 30, 2027. Connections that other apps use to access To Do tasks will continue beyond that date, and we’ll provide separate notice before those connections are retired. We’re also updating existing task integrations across Microsoft 365 to connect with Planner, so you’ll be able to create or manage tasks in the Microsoft experiences you already use. Although To Do tasks are already visible in Planner, they will not be migrated to the fresh private strategy. Customers using personal Microsoft accounts will need to choose another app. Our To Do transition guidance  will help you understand what’s changing and plan your next steps.

In a recent development, to Do was built on the foundation of Wunderlist, a wildly popular to do list app that Microsoft purchased in 2015. Wunderlist later shut down in 2020.

Sources indicate that microsoft’s shuffle, notably, leaves general consumers without a replacement app. To Do was available to anyone with a Microsoft account, where Planner is available only to enterprise/business people. So, for long-time Wunderlist users who followed Microsoft migration, this is the end of the road and it’s officially time to move to another app.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Rockstar Games has revealed several features that were scrapped during the development of GTA 6, including activities that were available in previous Grand Theft Auto games.
  • After years of anticipation, GTA 6 has finally arrived, introducing players to Leonida alongside the franchise’s newest protagonists, Jason and Lucia.
  • However, despite the number of activities available throughout the open world, Rockstar has revealed that several planned gameplay mechanics and returning features never made it into the finished game.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Rockstar Games has revealed several features that were scrapped during the development of GTA 6, including activities that were available in previous Grand Theft Auto games.

After years of anticipation, GTA 6 has finally arrived, introducing players to Leonida alongside the franchise’s newest protagonists, Jason and Lucia. The game has also earned a Metacritic score of 99, matching The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

However, despite the number of activities available throughout the open world, Rockstar has revealed that several planned gameplay mechanics and returning features never made it into the finished game.

Speaking to German outlet PC Games, Rockstar North development manager Rob Nelson and design producer Scott Mitchell discussed several features that were considered during development but ultimately abandoned.

According to recent reports, among them was tennis, which players could participate in throughout GTA 5. Rockstar had planned to bring the activity back for GTA 6, but its implementation failed to meet the developer’s standards. Mini golf, however, made it into the finished game.

GTA 6 features that were cut, per a PC Games interview with Rob Nelson and Scott Mitchell of Rockstar North:Tennis (planned, but didn't meet Rockstar's standards)Cinema and theatre visits (not interactive enough)CrawlingHome decoratingCraftingSource:… pic.twitter.com/NviyEdt2M9.

In a recent development, the developers also revealed that players were originally going to be able to crawl, decorate their homes, and craft items. These mechanics were ultimately scrapped, with some not fitting the game’s story or gameplay.

Cinema and theater visits were also removed, as Rockstar felt the activities were not interactive enough.

Nelson also explained how Red Dead Redemption 2 influenced the development of GTA 6, particularly when it came to storytelling and the relationship between its two protagonists.

The Western’s approach to pacing encouraged Rockstar to incorporate quieter moments into GTA 6, giving Jason and Lucia more opportunities for character development between the game’s action sequences.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • In a recent development, of the seven chips that have been detailed, the top-of-the-line Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC will be the one of most interest.
  • Industry observers note that if the leak holds up, the mid-range will be catered for by the Core Ultra 7 4870K and 4850K chips.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, A newly leaked document purportedly details no less than seven fresh Nova Lake-S desktop processors based on C1 stepping qualification samples, including 28-core models, three months before Intel is expected to officially take the wraps off them. The new leak, from VideoCardz, includes an Intel warning that clock speeds and performance may change before the final products are ready to be shipped. But given the fact that this rarely happens when dealing with qualification samples, it's believed that the chips will likely be released just as they are outlined in the document, if the leak is accurate.

In a recent development, of the seven chips that have been detailed, the top-of-the-line Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC will be the one of most interest. It will reportedly feature 28 cores comprising eight performance cores, 16 efficiency cores, and four low-power efficient cores. Its base efficiency core clock speed of 2.7 GHz is eclipsed by the 5.5 GHz boost speed its performance cores will reach, while 144 MB of L3 cache and a 125-watt power rating round out the main figures. According to the leak, it will be joined by a Core Ultra 9 4950K with the same core count and almost identical clock speeds, albeit with a much smaller 36 MB L3 cache. Beyond that, the report notes the Core 9 4900 BFC will be locked at 65 watts, have 22 cores, and a 120 MB L3 cache.

Industry observers note that if the leak holds up, the mid-range will be catered for by the Core Ultra 7 4870K and 4850K chips. Both will reportedly have a 125-watt power rating and 24 cores, but will again differ in terms of L3 cache — the former will have 144 MB, the latter just 36 MB. Both will boost to 5.2 GHz.

The report says the entry-level models will include the Core Ultra 5 4650K and 4650KF, both packing 22 cores and 30 MB L3 caches, and that they'll also have the same 125-watt power rating and top out at a boosted 5.1 GHz, according to the documentation.

The document reportedly states that all seven processors will support DDR5-8000 RAM, an increase over the DDR5-6400 that the Arrow Lake-S chips top out at. The specs also indicate a maximum of 256 GB of RAM is supported, with 24 CPU PCIe lanes and a 77 PTOPS integrated NPU. Integrated graphics are set to range from 2.9 to 3.1 GHz depending on the chosen chip, with support for the DNx, XAVC, JPEG-XS, and VVC decoding all included alongside AV1 High and Professional profile support.

It has been revealed that it has previously been reported that Intel is likely to announce its next-gen chips at an event in Berlin, Germany, between February 22 and 25, 2026. But we can also expect that motherboard manufacturers will show off products compatible with the latest chips before that — no doubt at the CES 2027 event in Las Vegas in January. It's already been confirmed that new motherboards will be needed if you blueprint on picking up any of the next-gen chips.

This latest leak comes weeks after it was reported that the fresh Nova Lake chips would "universally limit the maximum core frequency to 5.1 GHz when above 90°C." However, it's key to remember that the limitation only applies when the chips reach that temperature. Machines with adequate cooling will not experience that limitation, although it remains to be seen how easy these chips are to cool.

A GTA 6 player has created a website that allows anyone to play Rockstar Games’ latest release for free by remotely taking control of their PS5.

While GTA 6 is right now available on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, those without either console have been left waiting for Rockstar to bring the game to PC.

However, a website called PlayMyPS5 is giving players another way to experience Vice City without having to purchase the game or a console, while attempting to get the internet to complete its story together.

PlayMyPS5 broadcasts gameplay directly from a physical PS5, allowing visitors to join a public queue and remotely control the console through their web browser.

Each player is given five minutes to play before control is handed over to the next person in line. Players have 20 seconds to claim their turn, while remaining idle for 30 seconds will bring their session to an early end.

The website supports controllers, keyboard and mouse, and mobile touchscreen controls. Players can also watch others explore Vice City and communicate through a live chat while waiting for their turn.

There are no downloads, payments, or registration requirements to join the queue, and players can rejoin once their session ends.

The project was created after its developers realized their PS5 spent much of its time sitting unused. Now, they’re encouraging visitors to work together to complete every GTA 6 story mission.

The creators are also attempting to raise $993 to purchase a second PS5, allowing more people to play simultaneously and reducing queue times. Other PS5 owners with a copy of GTA 6 can volunteer to share their consoles through the platform.

Despite the fact that Moto Tag 2 has only been on the market for a few months at this point, Motorola is apparently getting Moto Tag 3 out in the not-too-distant future, and it’s already on sale (probably by mistake).

An Amazon UK listing went up this week for “Moto Tag 3,” a upcoming version of Motorola’s Android Find Hub tracker. The listing reveals the tracker in “Pantone Lucent White,” while a second image shared by Evan Blass shows the new model in a vibrant purple color.

There’s no indication of major changes in “Moto Tag 3,” with Motorola still claiming similar battery life, using a CR2032 battery, and supporting UWB in Android Find Hub.

The listing (thanks Matt!) explains:.

Motorola moto tag 3 helps you locate everyday items with precision and reliability. Using Ultra Wideband and Bluetooth technology, it works with the Android Find Hub network to track belongings both nearby and at distance. With more than 500 days of battery life powered by a replaceable CR2032 battery, it is designed for long-term use. Built-in privacy protections, encrypted location data, and unwanted tracking alerts support secure tracking in a compact, IP68-rated design suitable for daily carry.

“Moto Tag 3” is on sale from Amazon UK, though it comes with a “1-4 month” shipping estimate. This is almost certainly a slip-up, especially given the timing.

Recent findings suggest that this comes much earlier than expected. The original Moto Tag launched in 2024, with its sequel being unveiled in early 2026 before going on sale in the US less than six months ago in June 2026. Such an early move to “Moto Tag 3” is interesting, to say the least, so we’ll have to wait and see if there are any changes in tow beyond just the new colors. That mentioned, these are really nice colors. It’s also possible this is just the same model with a slip-up in branding – the model number on the Amazon listing is unchanged.

It has been revealed that we’ll have to wait and see what happens. Moto Tag 2 did debut at CES in January, and with Razr Flex also in the works, Motorola almost certainly would launch an updated tracker at the trade show if it truly does plan to do so soon.

This comes right as Moto Tag 2 has hit its lowest price ever at just $18.99 amid Black Friday sales.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

An Uber Eats driver in Massachusetts helped save an elderly woman after hearing her faint cries for help while attempting to complete a delivery.

Brandon McSorley had started delivering orders through Uber Eats to earn extra money ahead of the holiday season when he received an order from a customer in Carver on November 22.

The delivery took him to Cranberry Village, a residential community for people aged 55 and older, where he noticed something was wrong after arriving at the customer’s home.

McSorley told CBS News that the woman had ordered Tylenol and ginger ale. Because the delivery contained medication, he was required to verify the customer’s ID before handing over the order.

However, the house was dark when he arrived, and nobody answered the door. After waiting several minutes and attempting to contact the customer, he began hearing noises from inside the residence.

“I could hear, like, a faint calling. I thought it was potentially someone telling me to go away or something like that,” he said.

In a recent development, mcSorley remained outside until the woman’s cries became clearer, allowing him to hear her asking for help after suffering a fall. He immediately called 911 and waited for emergency services to arrive.

Recent findings suggest that first responders transported the woman to a nearby hospital. According to Carver EMS, she had been lying on the floor for approximately 45 minutes without access to a phone or a medical alert device.

Carver EMS Chief Michael Ryan credited the delivery driver’s actions with preventing the woman from potentially spending much longer on the floor.

Recent findings suggest that “A little voice in his head was telling him something was wrong here, and he followed up on it,” Ryan told CBS News. “From what I understand, she is expected to make a full recovery.”.

Speaking to WCVB 5, McSorley said he was grateful that his delivery had brought him to the woman’s home when it did.

“Just, right place at the right time. I’m glad I could be there and really do something to help.”.

It’s not clear how massive of a tip McSorley received from the whole ordeal, but he surely earned a five-star review.
